record.field: Drafts next week's posts from the running campaigns and their key messages.
Reads the running campaigns → asks the Marketing assistant for 5 posts → saves them as draft posts on the first connected account → a to-do for the owner to check them.
Drafts replies to new comments and messages on the connected accounts.
Finds new comments and messages without a reply → asks the Marketing assistant for a reply to each → saves them as draft replies → a to-do for the owner when there are new ones.
Prepares the newsletter from the week's posts and the running campaigns.
A draft mailing in Email Marketing
Reads the week's posts and the running campaigns → asks the Marketing assistant for a subject and a body → saves a draft mailing → a to-do for the owner.
Writes a one-line summary on each new lead from a marketing link.
A note on each CRM lead
Finds the leads that came from a marketing link since the last run → asks the Marketing assistant for a summary of each → posts it on the lead → a to-do for the owner.
Reads the results per channel and says what is working, what is not, and what to try.
A summary and a to-do for the owner
Reads Results by channel and source → asks the Marketing assistant for a short reading → posts it on this job → a to-do for the owner.
Flags running campaigns behind their targets, with the reason.
A to-do on each campaign at risk
Compares each running campaign's targets with the time gone → a to-do on each campaign behind, for its owner, with the reason. No AI question.
Searches the web for competitors' new offers and posts; saves findings on the brand.
Web search on the Marketing assistant's Hermes profile; competitors on the brand
Reads the brand's competitors → asks the Marketing assistant to search the web → saves each finding in Market changes → a to-do for the owner when there is something new.
The month's results, campaigns and spend, with three recommendations.
A report on this job and a to-do
Reads Results by channel and source and the campaigns → asks the Marketing assistant for the report → posts it on this job → a to-do for the owner.
Warns when a campaign spends faster than its plan.
A to-do for the owner, only when there is something
Compares each running campaign's spend with its budget and the time gone → a to-do for the owner listing the campaigns spending fast. No AI question.
Warns when someone has too many late tasks or reviews waiting.
A to-do for the owner, only when there is something
The marketing people in their department (Employees)
Counts each team member's late tasks and reviews waiting → a to-do for the owner naming who is overloaded (3+ late tasks or 5+ reviews). No AI question.
